supersedes.reason: Version 1 placed source-coverage roles on the packet theorem-shape axis. Version 2 separates those axes without mutating the frozen predecessor.

purpose: Versioned controlled values for packet summaries and declaration-level target classifications. The three axes are independent and no value grants source coverage, review approval, or implementation authorization.

value_semantics.exact_identity: A packet whose principal public results are exact identities and which does not also package a quantitatively distinct bound.
value_semantics.qualitative_support: A packet of non-asymptotic regularity, branch, or supporting propositions not chiefly defining an entity or giving a finite remainder bound.
value_semantics.audit_regression: A downstream packet of exact audit and regression declarations; it earns no source credit without a separate coverage role.
value_semantics.mixed: A packet with principal targets from more than one packet theorem shape, such as an exact identity and a finite remainder bound.

coverage_class.meaning: Role of the packet in source and infrastructure coverage.

novelty_class.meaning: Relationship of the packet's mathematics to bound sources and accepted dependencies.

semantics.required: A card-registry row with this ID is required and its packet-level classes must match this example exactly.
semantics.illustrative: The row demonstrates a representable combination but does not require a card-registry entry.

semantics.non_novel: A definition, routine consequence, or direct wrapper for which the packet claims no genuinely new mathematical content.
semantics.source_equivalent: Mathematically equivalent to a specifically bound external source target or pinned-library statement; never a synonym for agreement with an internal proof dossier.
semantics.equivalent_reformulation: A specifically bound external or pinned-library statement rewritten into a reviewed equivalent form whose translation is explained.
semantics.exact_source_generic: A packet coverage role for a theorem matching a collated source occurrence while remaining generic in functions or parameters; not a theorem shape and not a named-function application.
semantics.named_source_application: A packet coverage role requiring an identified named object and discharge of every generic hypothesis, reachability, and majorant-nonnegativity obligation.
semantics.audit_source_recovery: A packet coverage role confined to downstream Audit/SourceRecovery bridges that recover a collated qualitative source statement.

validation_rules: Packet-level and target-level values must be taken from their own tables.
Every frozen card and work packet records this exact schema version and digest.
Every packet target has all three classifications and relationship prose.

Every required_packet_examples row has registry_binding required or illustrative; required rows must exist in the card registry with exactly matching packet-level classes, while illustrative rows test vocabulary expressibility without requiring a registry entry.
An internal proof artifact alone can never justify source_equivalent.
A packet summary may use mixed only when its targets use more than one value.
Classifications do not imply reviewer pass, lean_ready, coverage, or release.
